text_block_list.text:
November, as the days grew colder and 
colder. Tomorrow, I'm going to watch the 
Japan Cup with Chrono Genesis and her 
classmates.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...It was truly flawless, Chevalier-san's 
race craft. However, this year, in that 
very same Bracket 1 Gate 1, is Ai-san. 
Which means—"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Chrono-chan, you need to dry your hair 
soon, or you'll catch a cold."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Just a little more... Just looking over 
the Genesis Factor...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Oh dear, she's in full-on immersion mode.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll dry your hair for you. We'll go 
to sleep once we're done, okay?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what a crowd! Isn't it like 1.2 
miles more packed than usual?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I guess everyone's eyes are on Ai-senpai 
after all, huh?

The Umamusume one generation senior to 
them— Almond Eye—

She achieved the Triple Tiara, winning the 
Oka Sho, Yushun Himba (Japanese Oaks), and 
Shuka Sho.

"And at this Japan Cup, Almond Eye would 
face Senior-class Umamusume for the very 
first time."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Also, isn't it partly due to how 
star-studded the lineup is?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
What an illustrious lineup. Seven GⅠ 
winners in total!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes... There are others to watch besides 
Ai-san. Especially Satono Diamond-san.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
She's a proven powerhouse who won the 
Arima Kinen in her Classic Year. Having 
just won her last race, the Kyoto 
Daishoten, she's riding high on momentum.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Satono Crown-san also conquered a Hong 
Kong GⅠ and the Takarazuka Kinen, after 
all—"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
As you all know, Cheval Grand-san is last 
year's Japan Cup champion.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
It is expected that last year's Kikuka Sho 
winning Umamusume will take the lead and 
control the pace, but—

text_block_list.name: Man with Glasses
text_block_list.text:
"The front-running strategy of a 
Kikuka-sho Umamusume—she already figured 
that out against Kitasan Black last year. 
If the race plays out the same way, she 
won't fall behind."

text_block_list.name: Man in Hoodie
text_block_list.text: What's with this all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes, having already grasped what it takes 
to run a winning race is a tremendous 
advantage.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Huh? Who?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I remember last year's Japan Cup. The 
showdown between classmates Kita-chan and 
Cheval-chan!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
When Cheval-chan won, Chrono-chan was 
bawling her eyes out.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... Their rivalry as classmates is 
just so intense... To begin with, they—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Comrades who repeatedly stood up against 
an absolute powerhouse like 
Duramente-san...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
And this time, Kita-san is the champion, 
competing in that very same dynamic...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Thinking of the complex emotions between 
them... the sheer weight of 
Chevalier-san's victory is immense...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: That was the most thrilling drama ever...!

text_block_list.name: Man with Glasses
text_block_list.text:
I know... That Japan Cup was a turning 
point for the generation...!

text_block_list.name: Man in Hoodie
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, how many times did the races of 
Kitasan Black's generation make my heart 
tremble...!"
choice_data_list: ...Could you two actually know each other—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
No... But I think the bond of Kita-san's 
generation is something that everyone 
acknowledges...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...A generational bond born precisely 
because they compete, huh.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I like that kind of thing.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Yes...! We want to build one too...!

And with post time arriving... The gates 
for the Japan Cup opened!

Just as predicted, the frontrunner 
Umamusume takes control of the pace. The 
early stages proceeded at an average pace, 
but—

As the leader tries to pull away, the pack 
chases relentlessly, speeding up more and 
more!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I won't let you pull away!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ! ...Ai is moving up!
choice_data_list:
Will this really last until the very 
end...?

Is this really gonna last until the very 
end...?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I won't let you escape! I'll definitely 
catch you!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye is in solo second! She climbs 
the hill, closing in on the leader!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: The one who will win isâ

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: It's me!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaaaah!!
choice_data_list:
!? —She still had stamina left in her 
legs?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The lead changes here! Almond Eye is in 
front!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Not done yeeeeeet!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye crosses the finish line! 
Sensational! Almond Eye conquers the Japan 
Cup!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
A-Almond Eye is so craaazy good!! She 
didn't win the Triple Tiara for nothing!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Blowing past the Senior Class Umamusume in 
one sweep...! This girl... is the real 
deal...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Gasp! ...What's my time—?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
What an unbelievable time! Two minutes! 
Twenty seconds! Point six!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: It's a world record!!
(Waaaaaaahhh!!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...Even the Umamusume down to 6th place 
broke the URA Turf 2400m record..."

Despite still being in the Classic tier, 
she took a complete victory against 
veteran GI Umamusume.

She stalked the leader within striking 
distance, shattering the world record for 
the 2,400-meter turf.

I was shocked by that phenomenal run—and 
at the same time, terrified.
choice_data_list:
(So Chrono is competing against her, 
huh...)

text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye's incredible feats gave 
everyone a premonition that she would 
become a legendary Umamusume.

There is no doubt she will become a 
brilliantly shining figure in history.

However, wouldn't that light overshadow 
Chrono Genesis's presence...?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ah, haha... Amazing... You're just too 
amazing, Ai-san...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
When she puts on a run like that, all I 
can really do is laugh...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...So this is what it means... to witness 
a historic moment...

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what race Almond Eye will run 
next! Maybe she'll challenge the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe next year!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
Already 4 GI wins in the Classic Year! 
Couldn't she even aim to surpass Symboli 
Rudolf's 7 GI wins!?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
âAh, on the electric bulletin board 
above the door. They're showing news about 
Eye-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Wah... it's true. We've witnessed a 
historic moment, haven't we...?!

Almond Eye is even on the public billboard 
screens. In just under two and a half 
minutes, I truly felt the racing world had 
been dyed completely in her colors.
choice_data_list:
Next year will be your Classic year, and 
yet...

Next year will be your Classic year, and 
yet...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ? Trainer...?
choice_data_list: Ai might steal all the spotlight.

text_block_list.text:
And interest in Chrono Genesis's 
generation might end up fading away...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"We're on the same Tiara route, after 
all... People are bound to compare us."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"If we can't surpass Ai-san, our abilities 
might be looked down upon..."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
This is a competitive world, so I'm 
prepared for that. But...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if the commu-members will get 
hurt hearing that evaluation...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...What if...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
If how people see me ends up making them 
doubt the ability of someone so dear to 
me...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Please wait.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
It's premature to assume things will come 
to that.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah, w-well... I... I can't say for certain 
that it's impossible, but...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I-In my opinion, history is... not 
something subjective, after all.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"I have no doubt... that Ai-san will 
become a star shining brilliantly 
throughout history."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, that will never diminish how 
much we are valued."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The true appraisal of an Umamusume or a 
generation can only be known by posterity—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: History proves it.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Yes. For example—the Golden Generation.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Numerous standout talents each made their 
mark, unfolding into a fierce rivalry 
among classmates.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Because of that, the following year's 
generation... wasn't regarded very highly.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
However, that evaluation was flipped 
upside down in the Senior year. T.M. Opera 
O tied Symboli Rudolf's record with seven 
turf GⅠ victories.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Their "Overlord Generation" is now 
considered one of the most talent-packed 
generations in history.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
And even the year after that, following 
Classic Triple Crown winner Orfevre and 
Triple Tiara winner Gentildonna—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Umamusume who have achieved results hold 
a presence that rivals any in history."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed... There are certainly cases where 
their achievements were overshadowed by 
legendary Umamusume..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...Just like Zenno Rob Roy's Autumn 
Senior Triple Crown."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Still! Rob Roy-senpai's great achievement 
is undeniably great!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's right. Great hoofprints are 
preserved as records.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Even as times change, records remain 
steadfast. You will surely receive the 
recognition you deserve...!
choice_data_list:
Records won't waver... Indeed, that's 
true.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—The time will come when you are properly 
appreciated, they say.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Yes. Without fail.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"If Chrono-chan says so, then there's no 
doubt about it...!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"If people rate you unfairly low, all you 
gotta do is shut them up with your 
skills!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Surpassing Ai-senpai! In other words, a 
world record!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! As expected of Gran-chan!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Our growth has only just begun! By this 
time next year, even Ai-senpai won't be 
able to keep up with us!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Let's not rush, focus squarely on the race 
right in front of us, and build up our 
results.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
No matter how grand the achievement, the 
path is paved with victory after victory.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Each and every race weaves the history of 
the Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: For me, it's the Hanshin JF first.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I'm going for the Asahi Hai FS! 
Eventually, I'll become the true Mile 
Queen!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
My goal... is to keep winning and climbing 
up, so I can stand shoulder-to-shoulder 
with everyone.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Me as well. I will pile up the 
victories.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you for making me realize 
that, Chrono-chan.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
N-No, not at all. It wasn't me... It was 
history that taught me.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The countless hoofprints of Umamusume 
etched into racing history—
